postal_system.postcode_rule: The current La Poste locator can return a five-digit code and nearest delivery office for a user-supplied location or address. The February 2015 UPU sheet documents the five-digit format and its routing-area, delivery-office and delivery-area components. A current assignment requires a permitted successful operator observation or a release-pinned rights-cleared directory; syntax, digit hierarchy, UPU examples and the dated ARTP report are insufficient.
postal_system.identifier_split_rule: Recipient, organization, apartment, residence, building name, premises and street, BP number, five-digit postcode, delivery post office, region, department, arrondissement, commune or locality, civic address identifier, 16-character NICAD parcel identifier, building identifier and AGID remain separate typed objects.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No rights-cleared nationwide official postcode catchment polygon release is bundled or identified. Post-office points, nearest-office distance, routing digits, administrative boundaries, ARTP workshop zones, BaseGeo layers, city building footprints, NICAD parcels, buffers, Voronoi cells, routes and model surfaces are not official postcode polygons; permitted generated surfaces remain derived non-canonical review geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: UPU and operator publications establish address structure and examples, not reusable customer rows. Store apartment, residence, building, premises and street, BP, postcode and delivery office separately with independent provenance, validity and visibility.
postal_system.building_rule: An exact building may be returned only from an exact rights-cleared artifact with a stable explicit authoritative civic-address-to-building or reviewed NICAD-parcel-to-building relation. Postcode, BP, address text, delivery-office proximity, BaseGeo building containment, NICAD text, nearest OSM building, overlap and model score are candidate context only.
postal_system.licence_rule: La Poste pages, UPU publications and database rights, ARTP reports, BaseGeo datasets and contractual licence, DGID cadastral records and official publications retain source-specific rights. BaseGeo acceptance, ANAT attribution, downstream terms, commercial-derived-product approval, annual term and deletion obligations must be pinned per artifact; OSM remains a separate attributed ODbL partition.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Senegal Law No. 2008-12 governs collection, processing, transmission, storage and use of directly or indirectly identifying personal data, includes declaration or authorization regimes and conditions third-country transfers. Recipient, subscriber, precise address, household, BP holder, NICAD parcel-person relation, owner, occupant, delivery and query-log data remain gated.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only rights-cleared non-personal immutable artifacts pinned to releases or Hub commits with verified digests. Personal or controlled address, BP holder, parcel, owner, occupant, delivery, credential and query material remains Senegal-hosted or otherwise gated and transferred only under an approved lawful third-country basis.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate permitted postcode observations, delivery offices, administrative objects, civic addresses, NICAD parcels, buildings and derived review surfaces to AGID cells without relabelling an AGID cell as canonical Senegalese postal, cadastral or administrative geometry.
